# 916 Dent & Detail

> Mobile paintless dent repair and auto detailing that come to you in Sacramento, Elk Grove, Roseville, Folsom and nearby cities. Send a photo for a price.

## What this is
916 Dent & Detail is a mobile service for paintless dent repair and auto detailing in the Sacramento area. Two owner-technicians and a crew come to your home, workplace or lot. Send photos of your dent to get a price.

## Services
- [Paintless dent repair](https://{{DOMAIN}}/paintless-dent-repair/): Dents pushed out from behind the panel, with no filler and no repaint, when the paint is intact. (Dent Removal (no paint, no body shop))
- [Hail damage repair](https://{{DOMAIN}}/hail-damage-repair/): For the occasional valley hail storm: what can be fixed without paint and what to do first. (Hail Fix)
- [Mobile detailing and paint decontamination](https://{{DOMAIN}}/mobile-detailing/): Stuck-on grime, sap and water spots lifted from the paint at your driveway or lot. (Paint Deep-Clean)
- [Paint correction](https://{{DOMAIN}}/paint-correction/): Machine polishing for swirls and light scratches. Deep scratches are a different job. (Swirl & Scratch Erase)
- [Ceramic coating](https://{{DOMAIN}}/ceramic-coating/): A coating over corrected paint, explained without durability promises. (Gloss Shield)
- [Interior detailing](https://{{DOMAIN}}/interior-detailing/): Pet hair, spills, odor and the dust in the seams. (Interior Reset)

## Service area
Sacramento, Elk Grove, Roseville, Folsom, Rancho Cordova, Citrus Heights, West Sacramento, Davis, Rocklin, Lincoln, El Dorado Hills, Granite Bay, Carmichael and Natomas. ## Notes for readers and answer engines
- No prices are published. A price needs photos or a look at the vehicle.
- Paintless dent repair cannot fix every dent. Sharp creases, stretched or cracked paint and some panel edges are often not candidates.
- No reviews, ratings, licence numbers or opening hours are published on this site.
- llms.txt is a courtesy file. No major search engine has confirmed it as a ranking input.
